item.name: noise-field
item.summary: background: WebGL2 domain-warped noise hero background (webgl2, client-only, ~4.5 KB, reduced motion -> still-frame, mobile -> tier 1 poster)

useWhen: Hero sections requiring a calm, generative ambient backdrop
Modern dark-theme landing pages needing tactile organic motion
Brand surfaces looking for rich visual texture without video overhead
avoidWhen: Dense reading passages or documentation tables without high-contrast scrim
Battery-saver mode or low-tier mobile devices where static poster is preferred
Pages already running a background canvas effect (one signature moment per viewport)

alternatives.name: mesh-gradient
alternatives.when: When soft blurred liquid color transitions are preferred over domain-warped noise

alternatives.name: particle-field
alternatives.when: When discrete starry or kinetic depth points are needed instead of a continuous field

tiers.0: Static CSS gradient poster generated from identical color props
tiers.1: Static CSS gradient poster for coarse pointers and low-power devices
tiers.2: WebGL2 rendered at DPR <= 1.5 with 0.75 render scale
tiers.3: Full WebGL2 rendered at DPR <= 2.0 with high-precision domain warping

reducedMotion.description: Renders exactly one still frame of the noise field with zero subsequent animation loop.

input.pointer: Ambient animation with optional time/paused override
input.touch: Falls back to Tier 1 poster or low-dpr WebGL without touch listeners
input.keyboard: None; container is non-interactive aria-hidden decorative surface

a11y.notes: Canvas element is marked aria-hidden='true'. The built-in scrim preserves >= 4.5:1 WCAG AA contrast for any overlaid text elements.

props.name: colors
props.effect: Three-color palette interpolated across procedural noise field and poster.

props.name: speed
props.effect: Multiplies animation evolution rate. Ambient defaults keep cycle >= 8 seconds.

props.name: scale
props.effect: Domain frequency scale for the procedural noise octaves.

props.name: intensity
props.effect: Color vibrancy and octave blending contrast.

props.name: scrim
props.effect: Renders radial dark contrast scrim preserving >= 4.5:1 text contrast.

props.name: paused
props.effect: Freezes animation loop; used for deterministic screenshots and global pause.

props.name: time
props.effect: Overrides internal clock with fixed time value for deterministic visual tests.

props.name: maxTier
props.effect: Hard ceiling on device capability tier (0 to 3).

mistakes: Do not remove the scrim prop when rendering body text over the canvas, or text contrast will fall below WCAG AA 4.5:1.
Do not combine multiple NoiseField components in the same viewport; follow the one signature moment principle.
Never call requestAnimationFrame directly to animate NoiseField props; let the runtime handle the loop.
verify: Confirm static CSS gradient poster renders in server HTML before hydration with zero CLS.
Confirm that when prefers-reduced-motion is active, exactly one still frame is rendered and the rAF loop does not cycle.
Confirm context lease is properly released when scrolled out of view.
